subject: MedCore pilot — interim sprint safety-net approval request
messages:
From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medcorehealth.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.shah@medcorehealth.com
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot pause risk — PO stuck in legal, request to keep sandbox live

David,

Quick heads-up from procurement: our PO is in legal review and finance says it may not clear before our pilot token allotment expires next Tuesday. The engineering team is close to completing integration tests and wed like to avoid losing the current environment.

Can Redwood either extend the sandbox for ~7-10 days or provide a temporary token top-up so the team can finish end-to-end testing while approvals run? I attached a redacted PO preview so you can see where it is in the workflow.

Appreciate any short-term options you can offer.

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Director, Platform Integrations
MedCore Health
Attachment: MC-PO-MC-2027-0873-redacted.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause risk — PO stuck in legal, request to keep sandbox live

Tom,

Thanks for the transparency and for sharing the PO preview. Were happy to help keep momentum here. Proposed approach: we can apply a one-time 10-day sprint credit (estimated ~120k tokens at your current cadence) to preserve the sandbox and pause the trial timer for that window.

Operational details well do immediately if you approve:
- Apply the sprint credit and tag the account so the trial clock does not advance during the 10-day safety-net.
- Exclude usage during the safety-net from funnel metrics used for trial health scoring.
- Schedule a 30-minute health-check call with Camila to validate the final integration checkpoints.

What we need from you to move now:
1) PO reference string (or forward the procurement thread) so billing can reconcile once the PO clears.
2) Confirmation that finance will accept a short note from Redwood stating the temporary credit is goodwill pending PO completion (we can draft the one-liner).

Copying Camila and Lauren to execute. If that timeline works, let us know and well apply the credit within the hour.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medcorehealth.com>, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-22T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause risk — PO stuck in legal, request to keep sandbox live

Tom  thanks for the note  looping in ops.

We can apply the 10-day safety-net credit now and attach a short confirmation note you can forward to finance. Ive also generated a one-page usage mapping to illustrate how the credit translates to runway (attached: medcore-pilot-usage-aug2027.csv).

If you confirm the PO ref here Ill:
- Apply the credit immediately and send the confirmation line you can forward to finance.
- Add DEAL-78211 to the internal reconciliation reference so billing links it to the eventual PO.

Draft confirmation (I will send once you confirm the PO ref):
"Redwood Inference confirms a temporary 10-day sprint credit has been applied to MedCore Health (internal ref: DEAL-78211) while PO MC-2027-0873 is in flight. Usage during this window will be excluded from trial expiry metrics."

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: medcore-pilot-usage-aug2027.csv (CSV, 1KB)

From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@medcorehealth.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.shah@medcorehealth.com
Date: 2027-08-24T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause risk — PO stuck in legal, request to keep sandbox live

David / Camila,

Please proceed with the 10-day credit. PO reference is MC-2027-0873; finance moved it to exec review Monday morning. The draft confirmation you suggested looks perfect  please send that line and Ill forward to our procurement contact.

This should cover the remaining integration tests and let the team complete validation without rework. Thanks for the quick response.

Best,
Tom Wallace
Director, Platform Integrations
MedCore Health
